_doc: Signature items of the hermits and sages (world-depth pass, schema.md). The seven legendary items this group owns in world_history.json (quy_khu_binh, co_hac, thuong_tang_kinh, soc_khi, tu_yen_lo, diem_duong_phien, ngu_nguyet_mai), written as named items with legendary_key. Three are held; four lie in sealed abodes (holder null, slot named). Unpriced proposals. No flute base exists, so the flute-blade uses phi_kiem.

items.name: Vase of the Abyss (Quy Khư Bình)

effects.name: Where All Waters Return (Vạn Thủy Quy Khư)
effects.rule: Once per fight, the first hit that would take more than a third of your health is poured into the vase instead and you take none of it. The vase holds it, and spills it as a ring of fire and frost around you (Ice and Fire stacks on every foe near you) the next time you fall below half health. At a Hóa Thần tribulation, the vase takes the last strike for its holder.

items.lore: A plain unglazed clay vase the height of a forearm, cold to the touch in any weather, said to hold a sea. Mạc Quy Khư carried it out of Phù Tang Cảnh in the year 0 (C001); it is older than the calendar. At his tribulation in 260 it drank the bolts meant for him (C029), and what it spilled tore open the realm of fire and snow. No one but its holder knows this. Legendary item quy_khu_binh.
items.build_use: The old man's last line: linh lực and a Thunder ward, and one blow a fight that simply goes into the clay.

items.name: Lone Crane (Cô Hạc)

effects.name: A Crane Crosses from the East (Cô Hạc Đông Lai)
effects.rule: In a Wind-rooted hand, each attack you evade sends one afterimage cut back at the attacker (sword damage, at most once a second). In any other hand the sword is only a very good blade and this rule sleeps.

items.lore: A long, narrow sword of Can Tương ore with a grey crane cut into the guard, named for Tô Thức's crane crossing the river from the east. Quách Vô Tích, founder of Phất Y Cốc, forged it in 760 for his own Wind and gave it to Tư Không Hạc Niên at dawn in Tống Khách Thị in 900 before he walked away (A138). Tư Không is pure Metal and has never woken its wind. Legendary item co_hac; its maker was unknown in the chronicle (made_by null) and is named here.
items.build_use: The sage's edge: sword attack and speed. Its real rule waits for a Wind root.

items.name: Mirror of Seas and Fields (Thương Tang Kính)

effects.name: The Blue Sea Becomes Mulberry Fields (Thương Hải Tang Điền)
effects.rule: Once per fight, the first Thunder strike that would hit you lands in the mirror instead, and you gain a ward worth half its damage. Out of combat, held over still water, it shows the holder that water as it was on a day they name (a scene for the Event Engine; one use a year).

items.lore: A bronze hand mirror whose back is cast with waves on one half and mulberry rows on the other. It came from Cô Phàm Các's sea hall, and Yến Tang Điền searched the western sea with it for 355 years. In 1060 it was in his disciple's hands when the tribulation struck, and it is the reason Đoạn Thương Hải lived (C180). Its face is a Light treasure; Đoạn has not seen it since. Legendary item thuong_tang_kinh.
items.build_use: The blind man's shield: soul and Thunder resistance, and one bolt a fight that goes into the glass.

items.name: North-Wind Breath (Sóc Khí)

effects.name: The Unspent Bolt (Vị Lạc Chi Lôi)
effects.rule: Your critical strikes leave a Frozen Lightning stack (Ice and Thunder at once); at 5 stacks a foe takes one frozen bolt and the stacks clear. The first time the sword is drawn after its seal is broken, the last bolt of its maker's failed tribulation falls on whoever holds it.

items.lore: Hoắc Hàn Quang forged it in 300 from glacier ice and the iron of the southern massif (Mộc Lan Thi: the north wind carries the watchman's gong; cold light shines on iron mail). In 699 he laid it on the stone of his cave and walked north with empty hands on Mạc Quy Khư's advice, and died (C014). Kỷ Hoa Ảnh sealed the cave with the sword inside in 702. Legendary item soc_khi, slot A-1 (the legendary text says 'sealed with him'; Lê Hoa Am's page has the cave empty and the sword alone in it, which this file follows).
items.build_use: An ice duelist's sword: Ice attack and crits that freeze into lightning. Whoever takes it takes the storm with it.

items.name: Purple Smoke Furnace (Tử Yên Lô)

effects.name: Purple Smoke on the Burner (Nhật Chiếu Hương Lô)
effects.rule: Craft edge: a pill brewed in it comes out one grade higher, and its poison (đan độc) is halved. The furnace still holds the second pill of the batch that killed Cao Đan Hà; whoever opens the lid first must decide what to do with it.

items.lore: A three-legged bronze burner gone violet with smoke, made in 500 and named for Lý Bạch's Incense Burner Peak, where the sun makes purple smoke. Cao Đan Hà's furnace, standing in her sealed abode beside the pill that killed her (C022). Úy Thanh Diễm and Đồng Hồng Lô both want it; Khuyết Vãn Hà knows where it is. Legendary item tu_yen_lo, slot A-2. There is no furnace base; the incense burner (huong_lo) stands in.
items.build_use: An alchemist's heirloom: poison resistance and healing in a fight, and the best furnace on the continent outside one.

items.name: Blazing Sun Fan (Diễm Dương Phiến)

effects.name: Noon on One Side (Bán Diện Chính Ngọ)
effects.rule: Each sweep of the fan lays Fire stacks on foes in front of you and strips one Ice stack from you. When you hold 5 or more Fire stacks on a foe, your next sweep turns them to a burst; once a fight, it also melts a frost ward.

items.lore: A fan of red iron ribs and fire-silk made by Cung Hỏa Vân in 450, the year he went to live in the cape's vents after the fire of Mạc Quy Khư's tribulation. It lies in his abode where his body was found burned on one side and frozen on the other (C013). Hồng Lô Cốc's founder came to the cape looking for its fire. Legendary item diem_duong_phien, slot A-4.
items.build_use: A fire caster's fan: Fire attack and long burns, and an answer to frost.

items.name: Plum of the Fifth Month (Ngũ Nguyệt Mai)

effects.name: The Falling Plum Tune (Lạc Mai Hoa Khúc)
effects.rule: Played between cuts, the flute slows every foe's arts by 10 % for 4 s; a cut made while the tune holds counts as a sword art and a soul art at once.

items.lore: A jade flute that unscrews into a short blade, made by Lương Lạc Mai in 600 and named for Lý Bạch's line: in the river city in the fifth month, the falling-plum tune is played on the flute. It lies with her in her sealed abode (C020). Her death has never been explained, and the flute is the clue. Legendary item ngu_nguyet_mai, slot A-5. No flute base exists; phi_kiem stands in.
items.build_use: A flute-sword for a Wind duelist: art speed and long statuses, cuts that are also songs.

items.name: Bead of the Unmoving Hour (Bất Động Thời Châu)
items.lore: A bead of clear stone with a grain of sand that has hung in its middle, not falling, for a thousand years.
items.build_use: Time held still: long statuses and linh lực.

items.name: Crane-Bone Pendant (Hạc Cốt Bội)
items.lore: A carved crane's wing bone Quách Vô Tích wore while he forged the sword; it was wrapped round the hilt the dawn he gave it away.
items.build_use: The edge, and the crits that wake the afterimages.

items.name: Threadbare Robe (Lam Lũ Bào)
items.lore: The same robe for two hundred years, patched by whoever sits next to him in the market; nothing on it guards anything.
items.build_use: Every point on the sword, nothing on defence.

items.name: Bell of the Still Pool (Đàm Ảnh Chung)
items.lore: A bronze bell sunk in the pool of Đàm Ảnh Thành; he hears through it what his eyes cannot show him.
items.build_use: Tide stacks, linh lực and the ear of a blind man.

items.name: His Master's Scorched Robe (Tiêu Sư Bào)
items.lore: What the tribulation left of his master: a robe burned through at the shoulders. He woke in it on the shore in 1060 and will not have it mended.
items.build_use: Health, healing and guard for the long sit by the pool.

items.name: Flute Between the Notes (Âm Gian Địch)
items.lore: Lương Lạc Mai's flute of Minh Cầm Phong bamboo, played for 340 years behind a shut door.
items.build_use: Song damage for Echo of the Dodge, and soul guard.

sets.name: What the Old Man Kept (Quy Khư Di Vật)

bonuses.effect: The World Before (Tiền Thế): when the Vase spills, the foe's clock stops for 2 s while yours runs (its arts, basic attack and companions wait, and its stacks do not count down), and each art you fire in those seconds lays one stack of every element you own on its target.

sets.story: Not made together: a vase from the year 0 and a bead from 400, kept by one man, which have learned to work as one because nothing else has stayed with him that long. Hermits make no regalia; this is what a life leaves. He wears the Primordial Mirror beside them.

sets.name: The Lone Crane's Things (Cô Hạc Tam Vật)

bonuses.effect: The Crane Wakes (Hạc Tỉnh): while all three are worn, Lone Crane's sleeping rule wakes in any hand: each crit you land (instead of each attack you evade) sends one afterimage cut back along the same line, at most once a second.

sets.story: The sword and the bone came to him together from his master at dawn in 900; the robe is his own. No one made them a set: he found that with the bone on his chest the sword half-wakes, and he has never taken it off.

sets.name: The Still Pool (Đàm Ảnh Tam Vật)

bonuses.effect: Hears and Answers (Văn Thanh Ứng): the first art each foe aims at you in a fight is heard before it lands: you evade it and answer with a tide palm that lays two Water stacks. Each Thunder strike you take restores 3 % of your linh lực.

sets.story: His master's robe, the mirror that took the bolt, and the bell he sank in the pool after he went blind. Gathered by grief, not made; whole while he sits by the water.
